# Laboratory Incident Procedure

If a safety incident occurs in the software laboratory, the first priority is to protect people from immediate harm. Students should stop work, warn nearby people, and contact the supervising teacher. The supervising teacher decides whether the room must be evacuated and contacts campus security when urgent assistance is needed.

After the immediate risk is controlled, the person who observed the incident completes the digital incident form before the end of the next working day. The form records the time, location, people involved, observed facts, and any immediate action. It must avoid speculation about blame. The laboratory coordinator reviews the report, preserves relevant evidence, and assigns follow-up actions. A serious incident is escalated to the faculty safety officer.

The purpose of the procedure is learning and prevention. The completed report is not a substitute for emergency help, and students must not delay contacting the supervisor while trying to fill in the form.
